provenance_note: All 1255 checks are recomputed by the reference; the published Bergant/Adelaide maxima are cited as a literature comparison, not graded.
reference: Independent python Method-of-Characteristics solver written by a second agent from a method specification and the case files only, without access to the page code, with closed-form cross-checks (Joukowsky jump reproduced to 1e-9 m, 4L/a wave period, partial-closure orifice value) and the published Bergant/Adelaide classical-DVCM maxima (reference MOC 102.48 m at 0.178 s for N = 32 against the published 102.7 m at 0.176 s). Every case input is stored in benchmarks/waterhammer.reference.json.
reference_citations: E.B. Wylie & V.L. Streeter, Fluid Transients in Systems, Prentice Hall 1993, ch. 3 (C+/C- compatibility equations) and eq. 2-8 (thin-wall elastic pipe wave speed, c1 = 1 - nu^2).
M.H. Chaudhry, Applied Hydraulic Transients, 3rd ed., Springer 2014, ch. 3 (MOC boundary conditions).
N. Joukowsky (1900), dH = a dV / g for instantaneous closure.
C.F. Colebrook, J. Inst. Civ. Eng. 11 (1939) 133-156.
A. Bergant et al. (2007) / TU/e CASA report 0729: classical-DVCM maxima 102.7 m at 0.176 s (N=32) and 102.5 m at 0.178 s (N=128) for the Adelaide low-velocity column-separation test.

W. Zielke, J. Basic Eng. 90 (1968) 109-115, laminar weighting function; K. Urbanowicz & Z. Zarzycki (2012), 26-term approximation; A.E. Vardy & J.M.B. Brown, smooth-pipe turbulent weighting coefficients.

tolerance.en: Single-phase heads 1e-6 m, pressures 1e-7 bar, grid and closed-form quantities 1e-12 to 1e-9 relative, times exact or one step on plateau ties, source flow 1e-9 m3/s; column-separation heads 1e-3 m, cavity volume 1e-4 relative, cavity opening and collapse counts +/-2; statuses and refusal rules exact.
tolerance.uk: Однофазні напори 1e-6 m, тиски 1e-7 bar, сіткові величини та величини в замкненій формі — від 1e-12 до 1e-9 відносно, моменти часу — точно або з відхиленням на один крок при рівних значеннях на плато, витрата джерела 1e-9 m3/s; напори при розриві стовпа 1e-3 m, об’єм порожнини 1e-4 відносно, кількості утворень і замикань порожнин +/-2; статуси та правила відмов — точно.
tolerance.de: Einphasige Druckhöhen 1e-6 m, Drücke 1e-7 bar, Rastergrößen und Größen in geschlossener Form 1e-12 bis 1e-9 relativ, Zeitpunkte exakt oder ein Schritt bei Gleichständen auf einem Plateau, Quellvolumenstrom 1e-9 m3/s; Druckhöhen bei Säulentrennung 1e-3 m, Hohlraumvolumen 1e-4 relativ, Anzahl der Hohlraumbildungen und -zusammenbrüche +/-2; Status und Abweisungsregeln exakt.
tolerance.nl: Eenfasige drukhoogten 1e-6 m, drukken 1e-7 bar, rastergrootheden en grootheden in gesloten vorm 1e-12 tot 1e-9 relatief, tijdstippen exact of één stap bij gelijke waarden op een plateau, brondebiet 1e-9 m3/s; drukhoogten bij kolomscheiding 1e-3 m, caviteitsvolume 1e-4 relatief, aantallen openingen en implosies van caviteiten +/-2; statussen en weigeringsregels exact.
tolerance.fr: Charges monophasiques 1e-6 m, pressions 1e-7 bar, grandeurs de grille et sous forme fermée de 1e-12 à 1e-9 en relatif, instants exacts ou à un pas près en cas d'égalité sur un plateau, débit de la source 1e-9 m3/s ; charges en séparation de colonne 1e-3 m, volume de cavité 1e-4 en relatif, nombres d'ouvertures et d'effondrements de cavités +/-2 ; statuts et règles de refus exacts.
tolerance.es: Cargas monofásicas 1e-6 m, presiones 1e-7 bar, magnitudes de malla y en forma cerrada de 1e-12 a 1e-9 relativo, tiempos exactos o un paso en empates en una meseta, caudal de la fuente 1e-9 m3/s; cargas con separación de columna 1e-3 m, volumen de cavidad 1e-4 relativo, recuentos de aperturas y colapsos de cavidades +/-2; estados y reglas de rechazo exactos.
tolerance.pl: Wysokości ciśnienia w przepływie jednofazowym 1e-6 m, ciśnienia 1e-7 bar, wielkości siatkowe i w postaci zamkniętej od 1e-12 do 1e-9 względnie, czasy dokładnie lub z dokładnością do jednego kroku przy równych wartościach na plateau, przepływ źródła 1e-9 m3/s; wysokości ciśnienia przy rozerwaniu słupa cieczy 1e-3 m, objętość kawerny 1e-4 względnie, liczby powstań i zapadnięć kawern +/-2; statusy i reguły odrzuceń dokładnie.

grid.*.why: pure IEEE arithmetic dx=L/N, dt=dx/a; steps integer exact.

steady.*.why: closed-form; Colebrook root converged to round-off; kv via sqrt of a difference.

status_kind / refusal.why: categorical; refusal.message graded on which rule fired.

node_extrema.*.H*_m, history, cycle_peak.why: identical explicit scheme; only boundary-root residual (1e-11 m) and summation order differ; no amplification in single phase.

times t_* and node/step indices.why: times are n*dt on the shared grid; plateau near-ties (1e-9 m / 1e-12 rel) can shift by whole steps (ambiguity 2).

source.*.why: root residual 1e-11 m / B (B ~ 360 s/m2 here) ~ 3e-14; 1e-9 leaves margin for summation order.

unsteady.Ju_max_m.why: sum of 16-26 exponential states; round-off only.

unsteady_re_range.*.why: minRe is |Q| at a near-zero crossing and depends on 1e-11-level flow differences; maxRe is ~Re0.

cavity heads/pressures (DVCM cases).why: DVCM switching (entry when H <= h_v, active when V > V_tol) can flip on 1e-11 differences and shift a collapse by a step; typical DVCM sensitivity in the literature (Bergant & Simpson 1999) is at the mm level once a cavity forms.

cavity.V_max_m3.why: integrated imbalance; inherits DVCM switching sensitivity.

cavity.openings / collapses.why: count of tolerance crossings at V_tol ~ 1e-12 A dx; round-off can add/remove a transient micro-cavity.

threshold_cavitation.first_j/first_t_s.why: p_abs <= pvap test on a sharp head front; if a node sits within 1e-9 m of h_v it may move one step.

process: Phase 1: a driver agent wrote the stored case inputs, the method specification and the page driver, and wrote no expected values. Phase 2: a second agent wrote the reference from the case inputs and the specification only, without access to the page code. Phase 3: the page outputs were graded against the reference with the reference tolerances unchanged; disputed points were adjudicated against the specification and every correction is recorded in the reference file.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: Standard-model wave speed and restraint factor
reference_decisions.decision: Use the input a unchanged (no restraint factor) for every hydraulic case; restraint factor c1 = 1 - nu^2 only inside the FSI c_f formula.
reference_decisions.why: method.md section 2 states the page model; a pipe-material wave speed is not defined by the hydraulic inputs.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: 1. Boundary roots solved numerically on the page
reference_decisions.decision: All boundary equations are monotone in q (sum of B q and q|q| terms), so the unique root is taken in closed form with the cancellation-free quadratic formula q = 2 Delta/(B + sqrt(B^2 + 4K|Delta|)).
reference_decisions.why: Exact root; differs from a 1e-11 m bracketing tolerance by <= 1e-11 m in head.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: 2. Time of an extremum on a plateau
reference_decisions.decision: Node extrema: first level within 1e-9 m. Global extrema: earliest level, lowest node, 1e-12 relative tie rule, scanning in (level, node) order.
reference_decisions.why: Graded definitions in cases.json.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: 3. Quasi-steady friction explicit at the foot
reference_decisions.decision: Explicit first-order R(Q_foot) Q_foot|Q_foot| with f(Re_foot) re-evaluated each step (same law as steady state).
reference_decisions.why: This is the classical Wylie-Streeter first-order scheme and what method.md specifies; stable at Cr=1 for these R values.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: 4. J_u signed, per node side
reference_decisions.decision: Signed J_u from per-side recursive states; R state of node N and L state of node 0 updated but unused; Ju_max taken over R sides j=0..N-1 and L sides j=1..N before each step n=1..steps.
reference_decisions.why: Signed convolution of dQ/dt is the Zielke/Vardy-Brown form (Vitkovsky et al. 2004 recursive scheme); the evaluated terms are exactly those entering C_P and C_M.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: 5. Universal mode m_k / shift
reference_decisions.decision: Per method.md section 8, which equals UZK 2012 Eq. (3.2) with the Vitkovsky et al. (2004) rescaling: m_k = Zielke m_k (A* cancels), n_k = n_k + B*(Re) - B*(2320) for Re > 2320, Re from |Q^n| of each node side at each update.
reference_decisions.why: Eq. (3.2) verified in the published paper; the per-node-side reading of the current Re is the page's and is kept, with the frozen-Re0 alternative reported in the universal_turbulent concern.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: 6. DVCM collapse step (revision 2026-10-15), all nodes
reference_decisions.decision: Routine inactive: H* = (C_P+C_M)/2 (interior) or the normal boundary solution (nodes 0, N). If H* >= h_v: single-phase restart, Q = (C_P-C_M)/(2B) (interior) or the boundary flow. If H* < h_v: recavitation, H = h_v, Q_L = Q_in, Q_R = Q_out at h_v, fresh cavity V = 2 dt psi (Q_out-Q_in) without V^{n-2} or history term.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 7.2 / 12.2; this is the Bergant, Simpson & Tijsseling (2006) and Wylie & Streeter ch. 8 treatment, so the earlier concern is closed.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: Statistics of a recavitation step
reference_decisions.decision: The step counts as a collapse when V^{n-1} > V_tol (the routine yielded inactive) and, when the fresh cavity exceeds V_tol, also as an opening and a growth event; it enters V_max, first growth and max_reach_ratio like any active cavity.
reference_decisions.why: Literal combination of the 7.2 collapse definition and the fresh-cavity clause ('counts as an opening (and a growth event)').

reference_decisions.ambiguity: DVCM recorded imbalance at a step where the routine ran but the cavity is inactive
reference_decisions.decision: The imbalance Q_out - Q_in at h_v is recorded as dQ^{n} and used two steps later, also for a single-phase restart and for a fresh cavity; 0 only when the routine did not run.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 7.2 ('imbalance recorded ... 0 if the cavity routine did not run'; fresh step: 'dQ^n is recorded'). Irrelevant for psi = 1.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: DVCM volume recursion V^n = V^{n-2} + 2dt[...] with entry test on V^{n-1}
reference_decisions.decision: Implemented literally: per-node arrays for V^{n-1}, V^{n-2}, dQ^{n-1}, dQ^{n-2}; a node not entered gets V^n = 0.
reference_decisions.why: This is the Bergant-Simpson staggered formula applied on the full rectangular grid (the two interleaved sub-grids at Cr=1).

reference_decisions.ambiguity: 7. Check-valve model auto, explicit ideal without pump, migration
reference_decisions.decision: checkMode 'auto' resolves before the run to ideal if pumpOn, else none; a state without the checkMode field is 'auto'; an explicit ideal also blocks reverse flow into a bare reservoir (q < 0 -> q = 0, H0 = C_M(0)); any other string after resolution is refused (checked right after psi).

reference_decisions.ambiguity: Flow-triggered dynamic check valve
reference_decisions.decision: As method.md 6.1 (2026-10-16 clause): each level until fired, solve node 0 with the valve forced open (incl. the DVCM branch at V^{n-1}_0 > V_tol or open head <= h_v); if q_open <= 0, t_trig = t_{n-1} + phi dt with phi = q^{n-1}/(q^{n-1} - q_open) clamped to [0,1] (phi = 1 if q^{n-1} <= 0 or equal); level n is solved with c(t_n) from t_s = t_trig + checkDelay; one-shot; warn if it never fires.
reference_decisions.why: Clause added to method.md; replaces the reference's own earlier reading (first solved q < 0, travel from the next level).

reference_decisions.ambiguity: FSI status (revision 2026-10-16)
reference_decisions.decision: warn if l = 1 - |G|^steps > 0.01 with |G|^2 = 1 - 2 sigma(1-sigma)(1-cos(pi/(2N))), sigma = lambda1/lambda3, or e/D > 0.10; else ok. The vapour-crossing warning would need the FSI transient, which is out of scope; no FSI case reaches the low-pressure phase within T.
reference_decisions.why: method.md section 2 / 13.2; |G| verified as the von Neumann factor of linear interpolation.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: Node 0 dead end behind a closed dynamic check (method 13.3)
reference_decisions.decision: Closed valve (c < 1e-5): q = 0, normal head C_M(0); if <= h_v(0) the cavity routine runs with Q_in = 0, Q_out = (h_v - C_M(0))/B, w = 1/2 in the reach ratio; cavity_node.t_first_s is the first level with V > 0.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: Order of ideal-check clamp and the reverse-pump refusal
reference_decisions.decision: Ideal check clamp first, so a pump with an ideal check never triggers the reverse-flow refusal; with a dynamic check the refusal fires whenever the solved q < -1e-8 while the check is open (c >= 1e-5).
reference_decisions.why: A closed non-return valve prevents flow through the pump; physically consistent and implied by section 6.1.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: 8. Bergant/Adelaide surrogate closure
reference_decisions.decision: Use the stored smooth-cosine 9 ms closure; compare MOC valve maximum with the published classical-DVCM values.
reference_decisions.why: Inputs stored as numbers in the case.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: 9/10. Profile mode HGL and off-node vertices
reference_decisions.decision: Initial HGL linear in chainage; nodal z by linear interpolation; vertex checks for initial vapour at the vertex x with the linear HGL; off-node interior vertex adds a warning (nearest node by JS Math.round).
reference_decisions.why: method.md sections 3, 4, 10.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: DVCM at node 0 with a constant-head reservoir
reference_decisions.decision: Not reachable in any case (reservoir head 22-260 m far above h_v); implemented with the head-given source flow for pump/check sources and a fallback Q_in = Q_out for a bare reservoir.
reference_decisions.why: A bare reservoir cannot sit at h_v; documented for completeness. The node-0 and node-N recavitation branches of the 2026-10-15 rule are implemented and not reached by any case (restart events occur at interior nodes only).

reference_decisions.ambiguity: Refusal order
reference_decisions.decision: inputs -> psi -> check model -> N range -> pump/valve/trip/check data -> step count -> friction applicability -> operating point -> profile -> initial vapour -> runtime. Each guard case triggers only one rule, so order does not change any graded value.
reference_decisions.why: Checked for every guard case.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: Status kind
reference_decisions.decision: err if refused; warn if any section-10 warning or cavitation notice; else ok. FSI cases always warn.
reference_decisions.why: cases.json definition.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: Dynamic check closure resolution 0.12/0.012
reference_decisions.decision: Evaluates to exactly 10.0 in IEEE double, not < 10, so no resolution warning.
reference_decisions.why: Same arithmetic in JS and Python.
